title: rep jimmy gomez discusses national concerns and local heatwave warnings
text:
Jimmy Gomez U.S. House of Representatives from California's 34th district | Official U.S. House Headshot
Jimmy Gomez U.S. House of Representatives from California's 34th district | Official U.S. House Headshot
Rep. Jimmy Gomez, currently serving as a U.S. Congressman for California's 34th district, has recently shared his views on various issues via social media. Known for his active engagement with constituents and public affairs, Gomez replaced Xavier Becerra in 2017 and has been vocal about national and local matters.
On July 8, 2025, Rep. Gomez expressed concern over an unspecified issue by stating "This should never happen in the United States." He referenced coverage on CNN, urging attention to the matter.
In another post dated July 9, 2025, he addressed Los Angeles residents regarding the summer heat wave. He advised: "Angelenos: Our first summer heat wave is here. Make sure you and your family are prepared for the heat and please don't forget about your pets." He also recommended following the National Weather Service in Los Angeles for safety tips.
Later that day, Gomez tweeted from Los Angeles saying "Looks like the truth hit a nerve. Just calling it like I see it, from the ground here in L.A." His statement suggests he was addressing a potentially controversial or sensitive topic.
Rep. Jimmy Gomez was born in Orange County, California in 1974 and graduated from UCLA with a Bachelor of Arts degree. He resides in Los Angeles and served in the California State Assembly before his tenure in Congress began.
